result:
Perfect! All tests now pass. The bug was in the merge condition at line 54 of `src/lib.rs`. 

**The fix:** Changed `s.start < last.end` to `s.start <= last.end`

**Why:** The merge logic needs to handle both overlapping spans *and* touching spans. Two spans that touch (one ending where the other begins) should be merged into one. The original condition only merged when the new span started strictly before the last span ended, missing the case where they start at exactly the same point.
